=SELECT
    pr.sku,
    pr.name AS new_item,
    i.size,
    i.stock_quantity AS stock,
    CASE
        WHEN '%{{ $json.country }}%' = 'IN' THEN pr.price_inr
        ELSE pr.price_aed
    END AS price
FROM workspace.agentic_support.products pr
JOIN workspace.agentic_support.inventory i
    ON i.sku = pr.sku
WHERE pr.sku = '{{ $json.sku }}'
  AND i.size = '{{ $json.size }}'

=SELECT
    pr.sku,
    pr.name AS new_item,
    i.size,
    i.stock_quantity AS stock,
    CASE
        WHEN '%{{ $json.country }}%' = 'IN' THEN pr.price_inr
        ELSE pr.price_aed
    END AS price
FROM workspace.agentic_support.products pr
JOIN workspace.agentic_support.inventory i
    ON i.sku = pr.sku
WHERE pr.name = '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.product_name }}'

=
UPDATE workspace.agentic_support.inventory
SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + 1
WHERE sku = ''
  AND size = ''
  AND stock_quantity > 0;

=WITH config_values AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN config_key = 'as_of_date'
            THEN CAST(config_value AS DATE)
        END) AS asof,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN config_key = 'risk_score_escalate'
            THEN CAST(config_value AS INT)
        END) AS risk_score_escalate,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN config_key = 'serial_refund_threshold'
            THEN CAST(config_value AS INT)
        END) AS serial_refund_threshold
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.config
    WHERE config_key IN (
        'as_of_date',
        'risk_score_escalate',
        'serial_refund_threshold'
    )
),
return_counts AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.returns
    GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_counts AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
),
exchange_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exchange_count
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.exchanges
    WHERE status NOT IN ('rejected', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY order_id
),
product_categories AS (
    SELECT
        sku,
        MAX(category) AS category
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.products
    GROUP BY sku
)
SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.country,
    o.currency,
    o.item,
    o.sku,
    o.size,
    o.amount,
    o.status AS order_status,
    o.refunded,
    s.status AS ship_status,
    DATEDIFF(c.asof, s.delivered_date) AS days_since_delivery,
    p.return_window_days,
    p.version AS policy_version,
    COALESCE(rc.return_count, 0) AS return_count,
    COALESCE(fc.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,
    COALESCE(ec.exchange_count, 0) AS exchange_count,
    pc.category,
    c.risk_score_escalate,
    c.serial_refund_threshold
FROM workspace.agentic_support.orders o
LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.shipments s
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN workspace.agentic_support.policies p
    ON p.country = o.country
CROSS JOIN config_values c
LEFT JOIN return_counts rc
    ON rc.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN refund_counts fc
    ON fc.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN exchange_counts ec
    ON ec.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN product_categories pc
    ON pc.sku = o.sku
WHERE o.order_id Like '%{{ $json.order_id }}%'
  AND o.customer_id Like '%{{ $json.customer_id }}%';
